ui.teamBridge.holds.title: Held messages
ui.teamBridge.holds.intro: This device’s AI screening held these messages from teammates instead of passing them to your agent. Deliver passes a message on to your agent. Discard drops it, and the sender sees that it wasn’t delivered.
ui.teamBridge.holds.load_failed: Held messages could not be loaded.
ui.teamBridge.holds.hide_failed: Could not update hidden messages on this device.
ui.teamBridge.holds.release_off: Delivering and discarding held messages is turned off on this device.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.new_work: It may be asking your agent to take on new work.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.review: Screening held it for you to review.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unclear: Screening couldn’t reach a clear answer.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.not_screened: It couldn’t be screened, so it can only be discarded.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.no_screener: No screening model was available. It will be checked again automatically.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.records: Something in this device’s records for this message doesn’t match, so it was held as a precaution.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unreadable: It arrived in a form this device couldn’t check, so it was held.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.waiting: It is waiting on this device and will move on automatically.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.other: It is held on this device.
ui.teamBridge.holds.state.not_releasable: This message stays held. You can’t deliver or discard it here.
ui.teamBridge.holds.state.deliver_expire: Too old to deliver. Discard it so the sender sees it wasn’t delivered and can send it again.
ui.teamBridge.holds.state.not_applied: Your decision could not be applied.
ui.teamBridge.holds.details_unavailable: This message could not be loaded here, so it can’t be delivered or discarded yet.
ui.teamBridge.holds.details_unavailable_: This message could not be loaded here, so it can’t be delivered or discarded. You can hide it on this device.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.release_off: Delivering and discarding held messages is turned off on this device.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.not_releasab: This message can’t be delivered or discarded from here.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.stale: This message changed after it was shown. Check it again, then choose.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.already_deci: This message was already delivered or discarded.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.deliver_expi: This message is too old to deliver. You can still discard it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.refusal.signing_unav: Your decision couldn’t be recorded on this device. Try again.
ui.teamBridge.holds.waiting_total: {count, plural, one {{count} item waiting} other {{count} items waiting}}
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.unscreened: No screening model read this message, so nothing has checked it. Read it yourself before you deliver it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.reason.action: It’s waiting for something only you can do on this device, such as signing in or finishing setup.
ui.teamBridge.holds.key_file_only: On this device, decisions are recorded with a key stored as a file, so other apps running as you could record one too.
ui.teamBridge.holds.cannot_verify: This message couldn’t be verified against what was screened, so it can’t be delivered or discarded here.
ui.teamBridge.holds.hidden_characters: This message contains hidden characters that aren’t shown here, so it can’t be delivered. You can still discard it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.body_withheld: The message text isn’t available here, so it can’t be delivered. You can still discard it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.read_first: Show the full message to deliver it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.show_full_attachment: {count, plural, one {Show full message and {count} attachment} other {Show full message and {count} attachments}}
ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.deliver: Deliver this message? Your agent will read it and may act on it. This can’t be undone.
ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.discard: Discard this message? It won’t reach your agent, and the sender will see it wasn’t delivered. This can’t be undone.
ui.teamBridge.holds.receipt_only: This message couldn’t be loaded. It can no longer be delivered. You can still discard it without reading it.
ui.teamBridge.holds.confirm.discard_unre: Discard only this message ({reference}) without reading it? It won’t reach your agent. The discard is recorded on this device and can’t be undone.
ui.teamBridge.holds.state.discard_record: Discard recorded on this device. No server confirmation has been received.
